responsibility: Implements GCC’s tree auto-parallelization pass for loops. It analyzes candidate loops for independence, reductions, profitability, OpenACC/OpenMP constraints, and transformability, then rewrites accepted loops into GIMPLE_OMP_PARALLEL/GIMPLE_OMP_FOR regions, creates helper functions and shared-structure communication for captured locals and reductions, and updates alias/SSA state so later OpenMP lowering can generate threaded execution from ordinary loops.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parloops machinery itself: loop dependence/profitability analysis and rewriting eligible loops into GIMPLE OpenMP/OpenACC parallel regions. Unlike gcc/tree-parloops.h, which only declares the query for whether a function was parallelized, this file contains the transformation pass and code generation logic.
